research_mode: official Police.uk and Home Office sources only; Scotland coverage and current 2026 open-data package boundaries; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.name: Scotland API coverage caveat
verified_claims: only British Transport Police supplies Scotland data to this service
displayed Scottish crime levels can therefore appear much lower than reality
limitations: the API is not a complete Scotland crime source

sources.name: Open-data page update date
verified_claims: the page was last updated on 23 July 2026
limitations: page update date is not observation date

sources.name: PFA current package
verified_claims: the current PFA table covers year ending March 2013 onwards
the published ODS is approximately 14.2 MB
limitations: package size can change by edition

sources.name: CSP 2021-2026 package
verified_claims: the current CSP package covers year ending March 2021 to March 2026
the ODS is approximately 48 MB
limitations: large file is a publication package, not a parcel dataset

sources.name: CSP 2016-2020 package
verified_claims: a separate CSP ODS covers year ending March 2016 to March 2020

sources.name: CSP 2012-2015 package
verified_claims: a separate CSP ODS covers year ending March 2012 to March 2015
limitations: classification changes across periods remain relevant

sources.name: CSP 2008-2011 package
verified_claims: a separate CSP ODS covers year ending March 2008 to March 2011
limitations: historical package must not be merged without reference-table versioning

sources.name: CSP 2003-2007 package
verified_claims: a separate CSP ODS covers year ending March 2003 to March 2007
limitations: early series remains sensitive to NCRS-era comparability

sources.name: Selected VAWG subcodes
verified_claims: selected VAWG offence subcodes are published from year ending March 2021 to March 2026
limitations: selected subcodes are not the full VAWG measure

sources.name: Drug offence subcodes
verified_claims: drug offence subcodes are published from year ending March 2021 to March 2026
limitations: subcode outcomes require offence and outcome reference tables

sources.name: Knife outcomes package
verified_claims: knife or sharp-instrument outcomes are published for April 2024 to March 2026
the package is a separate ODS
limitations: special-collection outcomes do not provide parcel observations

sources.name: Firearm outcomes package
verified_claims: firearm outcomes are published for April 2024 to March 2026
the package is a separate ODS
limitations: firearm outcomes package has distinct coverage rules

sources.name: Year-ending March 2026 outcomes
verified_claims: year-ending March 2026 outcomes open data is published as an Excel workbook
the listed file is approximately 38 MB
limitations: workbook edition must be pinned before extraction

sources.name: Alternate-offence outcomes package
verified_claims: alternate-offence outcomes are published from year ending March 2017 to March 2026
limitations: alternate outcome must remain linked to the originally recorded offence

sources.name: Transferred/cancelled March 2026 package
verified_claims: transferred or cancelled crime open data is published for year ending March 2026
the current file is a separate Excel workbook
limitations: transferred/cancelled records are not incident totals and require reason semantics
